entities.summary: Doria Loyce Ragland is an American social worker. She is the mother of Meghan, Duchess of Sussex and the ex-wife of American retired television lighting director and director of photography Thomas Markle Sr. Ragland holds a degree in social work and is a former makeup artist and yoga instructor. Doria Ragland was a performers & entertainers from Cleveland (b. 1956-09-22, Cleveland). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to economic history and geopolitics.
